bathtub.name: bathtub
bathtub.title: Bathtub
bathtub.notes: Print upright, as shown, with no supports: the standard Ender 3 PLA profile (0.2 mm layers, 20 % infill) is fine.
bathtub.about:
A clawfoot bathtub for the Moomin House, wide enough for Moomintroll to sit in, printed upright with no supports.

The sides flare outward as they rise and the rim rolls out over a 45° lip, so no surface leans out more than 45°.
Underneath, the tub narrows at 45° to an oval plinth, and four cone feet stand on the bed at its corners. The
inside is one smooth shell with a curved floor and a plug hole. It has no taps on purpose: a thin tap could snap
off and become a part small enough to swallow.

chair.name: chair
chair.title: Chair
chair.notes: Print upright, as shown, with no supports: the standard Ender 3 PLA profile (0.2 mm layers, 20 % infill) is fine.
chair.about:
A chair for the Moomin House, sized for Moomintroll, that prints upright with no supports.

The four legs are what is left of a solid block after two pointed tunnels are cut through it, front to back and
side to side. Their roofs lean 45°, the most an FDM printer prints without support, so the seat needs none. The
back is a slab with an arched top. The outer corners, the seat and the back are rounded; the bottom edges stay
sharp, because a rounded bottom edge would overhang.

chandelier.name: chandelier
chandelier.title: Chandelier
chandelier.notes: Print upright, as shown, with no supports: the standard Ender 3 PLA profile (0.2 mm layers, 20 % infill) is fine.
chandelier.about:
A classic hanging chandelier for the Moomin House, printed upright with no supports.

Features a drop finial base on the printer bed, a flared 45° gallery bowl, four candle holders
with tapered candles and flame finials, a central stem, and a self-supporting top suspension loop.
All overhangs are 45° or steeper, allowing clean printing without supports.

stove.name: stove
stove.title: Tiled stove
stove.notes: Print upright, as shown, with no supports: the standard Ender 3 PLA profile (0.2 mm layers, 20 % infill) is fine.
stove.about:
A traditional Nordic tiled stove (kakelugn) for the Moomin House, printed upright with no supports.

The kakelugn features a sturdy round plinth on the printer bed, an arched firebox door with raised
moulding on the lower drum, a flared waist shelf, an upper cylindrical tiled column, and an ornate
flared crown cornice. All transitions and overhangs are 45° or steeper, so it prints cleanly without
any support structures.

table.name: table
table.title: Round table
table.notes: Print upright, as shown, with no supports: the standard Ender 3 PLA profile (0.2 mm layers, 20 % infill) is fine.
table.about:
A round table for the Moomin House on one flared pedestal, printed upright with no supports.

The column widens into the table top in a 45° cone, the most an FDM printer prints without support, so the
underside of the top needs none. The top's upper edge and the foot are rounded.
